dialogues.speaker: Corder
dialogues.text: Please, officer, these goods need to be processed before the auction. If you could see your way to letting me deliver them...

dialogues.speaker: Fonck
dialogues.text: My apologies, Mr. Corder, but the Maison Gardiennage suspects that your goods have caught the attention of a criminal organization.

dialogues.speaker: Fonck
dialogues.text: Both you and your goods must remain under the protection of the Maison Gardiennage until the auction starts. Otherwise, who knows what might happen?

dialogues.speaker: Corder
dialogues.text: B—But... there's still so much to do before the auction...

dialogues.speaker: Fonck
dialogues.text: Do I have to explain the meaning of the word "must" to you, Mr. Corder?

dialogues.speaker: Doddamani
dialogues.text: I—I'd best be getting back to the ship... G—Good luck, Corder...

dialogues.speaker: Fonck
dialogues.text: Please wait here just a moment, Mr. Doddamani. The safety inspectors haven't finished checking your ship yet. Once it's done, you'll be free to return to Sumeru.
